notes.title: Geekbench 3.3.1
notes.content:
Geekbench 3.3.1, the latest version of our popular cross-platform benchmark, is now available on Steam and includes the following changes:

[list]
[*]Fixed a crash that occurred on Windows 10.
[*]Fixed a crash that could occur on 32-core systems.
[*]Reduced the memory footprint of the BlackScholes workload.
[*]Added support for High DPI mode on Windows.
[*]Fixed code signing issues on OS X Mavericks, Yosemite.
[*]Redesigned result view.
[*]Added L4 cache information to system information.
[*]Added support for the Mac Pro (Late 2013), the iMac (Late 2013),  and the MacBook Pro (Late 2013).
[*]Added the ability to export benchmark results to XML.
[*]Fixed an issue where processor frequency could be misreported on Linux.
[/list]

Geekbench 3.3.1 is a free upgrade for all Geekbench 3 users.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Geekbench 3
notes.content:
Geekbench 3 is Now Available on Steam!

Find out how fast your processor is with Geekbench.

Geekbench is a cross-platform processor benchmark that provides a set of tests designed to quickly and accurately measure processor performance. Geekbench makes benchmarks easy to run and easy to understand.
